description: This file defines a role service for a frontend application that manages user roles through fetching data from a database using the Supabase client. It provides functions to get a user's primary role and all roles, including internal helpers for normalization and logging.

methods.name: normalizeRole(role)
methods.description: Converts role strings to lowercase and validates against a known set ('admin', 'hr', 'learner'). Returns null if not valid or input is not a string.

methods.name: logRlsVisibilityHint(userId, data, error)
methods.description: Logs debugging information regarding RLS (Row Level Security) visibility issues or missing roles, helping troubleshoot database policy constraints.

methods.name: fetchUserRole(userId)
methods.description: Fetches the primary role of a user by userId, prioritizing admin, then hr, then defaulting to learner. Handles errors gracefully, always returns a role string.

methods.name: fetchUserRoles(userId)
methods.description: Fetches all roles associated with a user, returning a unique list of role strings, handling errors gracefully, and never throwing.
